subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt friendly session labels in CLI/TUI `/status` and the statusline now, and if so should the visible value replace the raw key or be shown alongside it?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but terminal-safety and raw-key selector semantics are product choices, and the item is already marked for maintainer/product review with a linked open repair path.

options.title: Adopt sanitized label plus key
options.body: Render sanitized label/displayName as the primary human label while preserving the raw session key in an adjacent copyable/detail position.

options.title: Adopt label-only display
options.body: Use friendly labels in the visible status rows and rely on secondary tooling for raw key lookup, accepting a bigger selector/copy behavior change.

options.title: Defer status surfaces
options.body: Keep the issue open or close the linked PR until maintainers decide that picker-only label support is enough for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt sanitized label plus key
recommendation.body: Render sanitized label/displayName as the primary human label while preserving the raw session key in an adjacent copyable/detail position.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-management and TUI/status history makes this the best available owner for the display-boundary decision.
